review_model.summary: Owner ruling 2026-09-29: honua-io has one human writer, so a second-human CODEOWNERS approval cannot be met in 2026.1. Release lines require the exact status checks, a pull request, resolved threads and no bypass; CODEOWNERS names the operator, who approves by merging. Promotion keeps its own independence rule (automation starts it, the operator approves the release-promotion environment). The two-person review rule moves to 2026.2 as an accepted limitation.
